decision.explanation: The documents describe three distinct individuals named George Horner: Sir George Horner (the lawyer and MP, born 1605) whose death date is consistently cited as 9 February 1677 in two documents while a third document contains a contradictory and likely erroneous date of 1777; George Horner (the politician, born 1646) whose death date is consistently cited as 11 March 1707; and George William Horner (the biblical scholar, born 1849) whose death year is cited as 1930.
